dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 12, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**ALMOST A PERFECT DAY IN BASEBALL AS LEAGUE-WIDE HOMERUN FRENZY CONTINUES**

Yesterday's MLB action saw several teams go deep, with a total of 17 home runs hit across the league. Trent Grisham led the charge, going yard twice to pace the New York Yankees to a 10-5 win over the Seattle Mariners. Grisham's 15th and 16th home runs of the season were part of a 3-for-5 night at the plate.

In other notable performances, Alec Burleson collected 3 RBIs, including a key sacrifice fly, to help the St. Louis Cardinals cruise to a 7-1 win over the Philadelphia Phillies. Meanwhile, Luis Castillo threw a gem, striking out 10 in a 7-inning shutout for the Chicago White Sox in their 5-0 win over the Cincinnati Reds.

On the mound, Tyler Mahle was nearly untouchable, striking out 7 in 6 innings for the Atlanta Braves in their 6-3 win over the New York Mets. His performance was matched by Eric Lauer, who tossed 6.1 innings of one-run ball for the Los Angeles Dodgers in their 4-2 win over the Kansas City Royals.

In the home run derby, Corbin Carroll and Trent Grisham led the way, with Carroll's 18th and Grisham's 15th and 16th home runs of the season standing out as highlights of the day's action.
